question: The government has introduced which type of visa for foreigners seeking traditional Indian treatments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ayush Visa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• The Government of India has introduced the Ayush Visa for foreign nationals seeking traditional Indian treatments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• Ayush visas are granted for one year with up to three entries.
 
• They can be extended annually for up to five years with valid medical proof.
 
• Foreign nationals must provide a certificate from a recognized hospital in India for extension.
 
• Applicants must show proof of self-funded treatment expenses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Purpose of the Ayush Visa**__

 __
 
• Promotes medical tourism in India focused on Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy (AYUSH).
 
• Encourages foreign nationals to seek traditional treatments in Indian wellness centers.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility for Ayush Visa**__
 __
 
• Foreign nationals seeking treatment in certified Ayush hospitals and centers.
 
• Patients must provide medical proof for visa extension requests.
